memorySampling: task_info MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO resident_size, sampled every 1 ms on a second thread while each pass runs; value = high-water mark minus the resident size just before the pass
pairingRule: pairs (a, b) with a before b in the systems order; label system-vs-reference when b is oracle, otherwise system-vs-system; differences are a minus b over the tracks where both have a value

statistics.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 of the resampled medians of paired differences

systems.boomboomboomkit-optimal: AudioAnalysisService.analyze(url:) at default options (TechniqueSet.optimal); grid = beat-grid tempo extrapolated from gridOrigin
systems.commercial-analyzer: a commercial DJ analyzer's BPM as recorded in the OA300 label file; version unrecorded, analysis mode unrecorded; no grid; OA300 only; a system under test, never the reference
systems.variant-comb-best-phase: Story 15.10 follow-up: the default grid re-anchored at the onset-comb best phase (internal BeatGridAnalyzer hook); BPM answer unchanged from the default
systems.variant-fixed-time: Story 15.5 fixed-time model, BPM read from its scores files; tempo families only; Python inference, so runtime and memory are not comparable with the Swift rows
systems.variant-joint-fit: Story 15.7: DSP stub observations -> metrical level selection seeded with the default BPM -> joint tempo and phase fit, on the default pass's decode; a nil at any step abstains
